plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp boxing strength-and-power start built for one 30-minute home session each week. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift so later loading can stay practical and repeatable. Weeks 2-4 build general force and explosive intent with low exercise count, safe movement choices, and just enough accessory work to support punching posture and trunk stiffness. Main program loading begins in Week 2.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body strength, basic explosive intent, and trunk support with simple repeatable work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly harder loading while keeping weekly fatigue easy to recover from beside boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength with a lower dose and express it through faster crisp jumps and throws.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as fast as possible. Land softly and stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low stable box and land quietly in a solid stance.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Pause briefly at the bottom and jump straight up without a dip-and-rebound.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few progressively heavier sets, then work up to one hard clean top set of 3-5 reps. This establishes your starting strength baseline for later weeks. Keep torso tall and depth consistent.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can set your starting numbers.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if one dumbbell is too light or awkward to hold.

exercises.name: 1a. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use a variation that keeps 1-2 clean reps in reserve. Move fast up and stay braced.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench, box, or table if floor reps are too hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Press

exercises.name: 1b. One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull elbow toward hip and keep the torso steady. Use a load that leaves 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Row

exercises.name: Front Plank
